import subprocess,json
u='prediction-a2z-v4-model@A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2.service'
p=subprocess.run(['journalctl','--user','-u',u,'--since','2026-10-07 21:13:00','--until','2026-10-07 21:13:30','--no-pager'],capture_output=True,text=True)
lines=(p.stdout or '').splitlines()
sel=[]
for line in lines:
    if any(k in line for k in ('SUPERVISOR_STATE','USAGE_LIMIT','TEMPFAIL','Traceback','ERROR','Exception','Main process exited','Failed with result','retry_at','checkpoint','WORKER_START')):
        sel.append(line[-1200:])
print('ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_TEMPFAIL_LINES',flush=True)
print('ERROR='+json.dumps(sel[-12:],separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1)
